source_policy: DLC provenance, objectives, Ultimate Finish structure, and baseline rewards are restored from the previously staged source-backed dataset. Exact reward-slot/drop attribution remains separate.

records.name: Seeking Fighters for Tournament!
objectives: Keep Goku and Vegeta above 50% health
Defeat SSGSS Goku and SSGSS Vegeta
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat SSGSS Goku and SSGSS Vegeta after preserving the allies above 50% health.

records.name: Universe 6 in a Fix!
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Omega Shenron and Super 17 while preserving all allies.

records.name: Warriors of Universes 6 & 7!
objectives: Clear with at least 10 minutes remaining
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Hit after meeting the time condition.

records.name: Vados the Talent Scout
objectives: Defeat Vados and the revived enemies
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Vados and the revived enemies while preserving Vados above 80% health.
rewards: How Dare You...! That's My Bulma

records.name: Champa's Hellish Holiday
records.ultimate_finish: Fight off Champa after the time condition.

records.name: A Destructive Showdown!
objectives: Keep Beerus and Whis above 50% health
records.ultimate_finish: Fight off Beerus and Whis while preserving their health above 50%.
rewards: You're Just Pieces in a Game

records.name: The Future's Greatest Hope!
objectives: Defeat SSGSS Goku and SSGSS Vegeta
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat SSGSS Goku and SSGSS Vegeta while preserving Future Trunks above 50% health.

records.name: Doppelganger Dispute!
objectives: Defeat SSGSS Goku and Future Trunks
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat SSGSS Goku and Future Trunks after the time condition.
rewards: Now, give your father a message for me.

records.name: A Fateful Fight With Deity!
objectives: Defeat Zamasu and Rosé Goku Black
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Zamasu and Rosé Goku Black while preserving all allies.
rewards: I really do love being immortal.
I like you better when you're mad!

records.name: Heretics from a Dark World
objectives: Keep Rosé Goku Black above 50% health
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Mira while preserving Rosé Goku Black above 50% health.
rewards: This fight is only just beginning!
I shall show you my great godly might!

records.name: The Zero Mortal Plan
objectives: Defeat Rosé Goku Black and Super 17
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Rosé Goku Black and Super 17 after the time condition.
rewards: I feel it... Everyone, lend me your power!

records.name: Advent of the Mighty God Zamasu!
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Android 17 and the remaining enemies while preserving all allies.
rewards: Sorry. You were way open there.
I ain't losin'! Here's my full power!
I'm never going to forgive him!

records.name: Birth of the Ultimate Majin!
objectives: Keep Majin Buu (Gohan Abs.) above 50% health
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat all Majin Buus while preserving the allied Majin Buu above 50% health.
rewards: I'll make good use of you!

records.name: The Majin Revival Plan
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Dabura and Kid Buu after the time condition.

records.name: Extreme Battle with Android 13!
objectives: Defeat all enemies without losing any allies
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Androids 13 and 17 while preserving all allies.

records.name: A Hero's Duty
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Dabura and Omega Shenron after the time condition.
rewards: If I don't do it, who will?
Earth is in your hands now!

records.name: A Dance of Swords
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Future Trunks and Tapion after the time condition.

records.name: Beerus's Tournament Troubles
objectives: Defeat Golden Frieza and the others
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Golden Frieza and the remaining enemies while preserving Beerus above 50% health.

records.name: A Ranger's Duty
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Great Ape Nappa after the time condition.
rewards: Time to get serious, I guess.

records.name: Whis's Special Training
objectives: Defeat all Jirens before one leaves
records.ultimate_finish: Defeat Beerus, Whis, and Jiren after preventing any Jiren from leaving.
